audience: craft and trade businesses that plan jobs and employees in Craftboxx

useCases.title: See the assignments planned for next week
useCases.text: List assignments for a date range or for one employee, with project, time and state.

useCases.title: Review the timesheets of a month
useCases.text: List the timesheets of the employees with working time and break time.

useCases.title: Check who is away on which days
useCases.text: List the absences of the employees with the type and the dates. Plan the assignments around the days that people are away.

useCases.title: Read a project and its job documentations
useCases.text: Open a project for its customer and number. List the job documentations that the team wrote on the assignments.

useCases.title: Look up the material catalog
useCases.text: List the articles with manufacturer, unit price and VAT rate.

useCases.title: Create a customer and a project
useCases.text: Create a new customer. Then create a project for that customer.
